description: Real, live-verified finding-ID prefixes for crAPI (http://localhost:8888), from docs/10-implementation-plan-ph1b.md Steps 1, 3, and 4's measure-fp-rate.sh run. idor- count varies with how many mechanic reports exist in the instance, so it's a prefix, not an exact list.
